ALTER TABLE public.missions
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reward_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy',
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS escrow_total_credits integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS escrow_remaining_credits integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS escrow_refunded boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_fee_duration_days integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tester_announcement text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;

DO $check$
BEGIN

        WHERE conrelid = 'public.missions'::regclass

                m.status as mission_status,

private fun persistDurableDraft() {
        val uid = repository.currentUserId() ?: return
        val state = _uiState.value
        val boundDate = currentBoundDate
        val currentBoot = System.currentTimeMillis() - SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        val bootCount = getBootCount()
        val draft = MissionReportDraft(
            userId = uid,
            campaignId = campaignId,
            missionId = missionId,
            reportDate = boundDate,
            rating = state.rating,
            comment = state.comment,
            testStartedAtMs = state.testStartedAtMs,
            bootTimeMs = if (state.testStartedAtMs != null) currentBoot else null,
            bootCount = if (state.testStartedAtMs != null) bootCount else null,
            preparedImages = state.preparedScreenshots.map {
                DraftAttachment(
                    uploadId = it.uploadId,
                    filePath = it.file.absolutePath,
                    thumbnailPath = it.thumbnailFile?.absolutePath,
                    imageHash = it.imageHash,
                    sizeBytes = it.sizeBytes,
                    contentType = it.contentType,
                )
            }
        )
        MissionReportDraftStore.saveDraft(appContext, draft)
    }

    fun loadData() {
        val boundDate = currentBoundDate
        val loadRevision = userEditRevision
        loadDataJob?.cancel()
        loadDataJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, errorMessage = null) }
            try {
                val camp = repository.getCampaign(campaignId)
                val missionList = repository.getOpenMissions(forceRefresh = true)
                val targetMission = missionList.firstOrNull { it.id == missionId && it.campaignId == campaignId }
                    ?: repository.getCampaignMission(campaignId, missionId)?.takeIf { it.campaignId == campaignId }

                if (boundDate != currentBoundDate) return@launch

                if (camp == null || targetMission == null) {
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, errorMessage = localizer.get(R.string.mission_not_found)) }
                    return@launch
                }

                val myTodayMissionRep = repository.getMyTodayMissionReport(campaignId, missionId, boundDate)
                if (boundDate != currentBoundDate) return@launch

                val isJoined = targetMission.hasJoined == true || targetMission.hasCompleted == true || myTodayMissionRep != null
                val uid = repository.currentUserId().orEmpty()

                val durableDraft = MissionReportDraftStore.loadDraft(appContext, uid, campaignId, missionId, boundDate)
                val restoredComment = when {
                    durableDraft != null -> durableDraft.comment
                    _uiState.value.comment.isNotBlank() -> _uiState.value.comment
                    myTodayMissionRep != null -> myTodayMissionRep.content

package com.ntt.crosstest.data

import android.app.Application
import com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels.MissionCreateUiState
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
class MissionRewardModesUnitTest {

    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()

    @Test
    fun testMissionRewardModeProperties() {
        val onceMission = Mission(
            id = "m1",
            title = "Once Mission",
            rewardCredits = 20,
            maxParticipants = 5,
            durationDays = 3,
            rewardMode = "once",
            escrowTotalCredits = 100,
            escrowRemainingCredits = 80,
            version = 2,
        )
        assertTrue(onceMission.isOnceMode)
        assertFalse(onceMission.isDailyMode)
        assertFalse(onceMission.isLegacyMode)
        assertEquals(20, onceMission.rewardCredits)
        assertEquals(100, onceMission.escrowTotalCredits)
        assertEquals(80, onceMission.escrowRemainingCredits)
        assertEquals(2, onceMission.version)

        val dailyMission = Mission(
            id = "m2",
            title = "Daily Mission",
            rewardCredits = 15,
            maxParticipants = 2,
            durationDays = 3,
            rewardMode = "daily",
            escrowTotalCredits = 90,

    }

    @Test
    fun testMissionCreateUiStateBudgetCalculations() {
        // Once mode: 5 participants, 3 days, 20 credits/participant
        // fee = 50 * 3 = 150
        // escrow = 5 * 20 = 100
        // total = 250
        val onceState = MissionCreateUiState(
            rewardMode = "once",
            participants = 5,
            days = 3,
            rewardCredits = "20",
        )
        assertEquals(150, onceState.feeCredits)
        assertEquals(100, onceState.escrowCredits)
        assertEquals(250, onceState.totalCostCredits)
        assertTrue(onceState.estimatedEndsAtText.isNotBlank())

        // Daily mode: 2 participants, 3 days, 15 credits/day
        // fee = 50 * 3 = 150
        // escrow = 2 * 3 * 15 = 90
        // total = 240
        val dailyState = MissionCreateUiState(
            rewardMode = "daily",
            participants = 2,
            days = 3,
            rewardCredits = "15",
        )
        assertEquals(150, dailyState.feeCredits)
        assertEquals(90, dailyState.escrowCredits)
        assertEquals(240, dailyState.totalCostCredits)
        assertTrue(dailyState.estimatedEndsAtText.isNotBlank())
    }

    @Test

            campaignId = "c1",
            userId = "u1",
            submissionContext = "mission",
            missionId = "m1",
            missionRewardMode = "once",
        )
        assertTrue(onceReport.isMissionReport)
        assertTrue(onceReport.isOnceMission)
        assertFalse(onceReport.isDailyMission)

        val dailyReport = TesterReport(
            id = "r2",
            campaignId = "c1",
            userId = "u1",
            submissionContext = "mission",
            missionId = "m2",
            missionRewardMode = "daily",
        )
        assertTrue(dailyReport.isMissionReport)
        assertFalse(dailyReport.isOnceMission)
        assertTrue(dailyReport.isDailyMission)

        assertFalse(appTestReport.isMissionReport)
        assertFalse(appTestReport.isOnceMission)
        assertFalse(appTestReport.isDailyMission)
    }

    fun testDraftStoreOnceModeDurableDate() {

            reportDate = "once",

            campaignId = "c1",
            title = "Test V2",
            description = "Desc",
            maxParticipants = 10,
            durationDays = 4,

            success = true,
            missionId = "m1",
            termsModified = true,

            escrowDiff = -30,

            version = 2,

        assertEquals(2, decodedEdit.version)

        assertTrue(decodedDel.success)

        assertEquals("Violation", decodedDel.reason)
    }
